messages:
Maya: Heads-up — RainShadow's audit team just replied; they insist on 13 months of immutable KMS + S3 access logs. said it's a blocker for their compliance sign-off.
Jordan: noted. our private/VPC onboarding assumes customer-managed CMK + CloudTrail -> customer S3 bucket. retention controlled by their lifecycle rules.
Tess: their wording is "immutable 13 months" — could imply Object Lock/legal hold. do we offer a hosted immutable option?
Jordan: we don't by default. options: (1) customer enables S3 Object Lock + Legal Hold on their bucket (they'll need to create the bucket with Object Lock enabled), or (2) Redwood provides a hosted retention service as an add-on (requires legal).
Arjun: technical clarifications: CloudTrail must record KMS events (Management events) and S3 Data Events for object-level access. example CloudTrail filter: `{"eventSelectors":[{"ReadWriteType":"All","IncludeManagementEvents":true,"DataResources":[{"Type":"AWS::S3::Object","Values":["arn:aws:s3:::rainshadow-logs/"]}]}]}`.
Arjun: sample lifecycle to approximate 13 months (395 days):
```
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket rainshadow-logs --lifecycle-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ID":"keep-13-months","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":395}}]}'
```
Maya: good — can we be explicit in the runbook: "To meet 13mo, enable CloudTrail (management + data events) -> send to customer bucket + set lifecycle to 395 days OR use S3 Object Lock for immutability". I'll send that wording to the customer.
Tess: I'll flag renewal risk until they accept one of those paths. if they ask Redwood to host immutable logs, estimate a pricing delta and note legal review.
Jordan: infra check: forwarder for RainShadow currently at sample_rate=1.0, delivery healthy. audit-exporter-bot: last push 2025-11-03T14:22Z, no failures.
audit-exporter-bot: Delivery OK — 0 failed uploads in last 30d.
Arjun: also mention KMS rotation history: we recommend enabling AWS CloudTrail Insight + logging for KMS API calls: CreateKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, DisableKeyRotation, EnableKeyRotation, ReEncrypt. retention handled by bucket lifecycle.
Maya: action items:
- Jordan: update onboarding runbook to include CloudTrail sample selector + lifecycle snippet + clear note that default is customer-managed retention.
- Arjun: add brief note about S3 Object Lock/legal-hold steps and a sample CLI to enable lifecycle for 395 days.
- Tess: add renewal-risk tag and create pricing estimate for Redwood-hosted immutable retention; link to ticket CS-2025-4891 (new).
Maya: I'll draft the customer reply with the two paths (self-manage lifecycle vs purchase hosted retention) and ETA.
Jordan: ack, doc PR coming today.
Arjun: ack, will post snippets in the runbook PR.
Tess: ack, putting renewal flag as "monitoring" until they confirm.
Maya: replied to RainShadow with options + next steps. moving follow-ups into ticket CS-2025-4891. :white_check_mark:
